global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and fresh green onions. A single nori sheet rests atop, all served in a rustic ceramic bowl against a dark, softly lit background.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, slightly reflective table surface curves gently around the bowl's base, showing subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: Cream-colored ceramic bowl with two dark concentric rings near rim, smooth glazed surface, slightly chipped edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and pork, glossy surface, rich amber color, thin strands submerged.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, and crinkled, with a slightly uneven, textured surface and visible layered folds.
regions.meat: The chashu pork slice shows a glistening, caramelized surface with a tender, layered texture and irregular, slightly charred edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as two golden-brown, glossy, rectangular pieces with slightly uneven, fibrous surfaces.
